title: General Topology II
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is one of the requirements in topology to limit the size of the object that is under consideration.
Separability is one of the requirements in topology to limit the size of the object that is under consideration.
Fill in the blank: ______ are derived from the course competencies and objectives.
The modules are derived from the course competencies and objectives.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the central point which help to measure your achievement or success in the course.
The intended learning outcome(s) is the central point which help to measure your achievement or success in the course.
Fill in the blank: ______ is an abstraction of metric spaces.
A topological space is an abstraction of metric spaces.
Fill in the blank: ______ are used in algebraic topology to classify topological spaces.
Homotopy groups are used in algebraic topology to classify topological spaces.
fib: ______ is a topological property and is a powerful tool in proofs of well-known results.
Connectedness is a topological property and is a powerful tool in proofs of well-known results.
______ is a collection of open sets that covers a space.
An open cover is a collection of open sets that covers a space.
______ are a special type of topological space that is particularly significant.
Metric spaces are a special type of topological space that is particularly significant.
